scenes.say: You can run an AI front desk for almost nothing. Here's the stack.

scenes.title: The low-cost stack
items: n8n Community Edition: free to self-host
AI: Groq free tier, or a local model with Ollama
Email: the clinic's own mailbox over SMTP
scenes.say: n8n's community edition is free to self-host. For the AI, use a free tier or a local model with Ollama. Send email through the clinic's own mailbox, and use a Google Sheet as the CRM.
scenes.caption: Self-hosted n8n + free-tier or local AI + Google Sheet

cards.title: Honest limits
lines: Local models need a decent machine.
Hosting n8n still needs a server or a spare PC.

scenes.say: Be honest with clients about the limits. Free tiers have rate limits, local models need decent hardware, and n8n still needs somewhere to run.
scenes.caption: Know the limits before you promise "free"
